subject: ss-haematology
title: Plasma cell disorders myeloma thresholds amyloidosis and Waldenstrom
refs: Harrison Principles of Internal Medicine 22e Ch 116 Plasma Cell Disorders

steps.tx: Clonal plasma cell excess builds in three tiers. **MGUS** (monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance, silent clone) needs serum **M protein** (abnormal antibody) under **3** grams per decilitre and marrow clonal plasma cells under **10** percent. **Smouldering myeloma** (SMM, high burden silent disease) carries marrow clonal cells **10** to **60** percent or M protein above **3** grams per decilitre without end organ damage. **Active myeloma** (MM, symptomatic disease) adds myeloma defining events.
steps.say: MGUS, smouldering myeloma and active myeloma are three tiers of clonal excess. MGUS needs M protein below three grams in serum. Active myeloma has end organ damage features.

steps.tx: **SLiM CRAB** (myeloma defining events) settles treatment need. **SLiM** features include marrow clonal plasma cells **60** percent or more, involved to uninvolved **free light chain ratio** (abnormal antibody chains) **100** or more, and more than **1** focal lesion on MRI (magnetic resonance imaging). **CRAB** features are hypercalcaemia, renal failure, anaemia and bone lesions from the clone. Any single **SLiM** or **CRAB** feature with clonal excess above **10** percent starts therapy.
steps.say: SLiM CRAB features determine when myeloma needs treatment. Sixty percent marrow clonal cells is a treatment trigger. A single SLiM or CRAB feature starts therapy. Any one feature is enough for immediate treatment.

steps.tx: **Multiple myeloma** (MM, malignant plasma cell disease) strikes older adults with median age near **70** years and **IgG** (antibody class) in about **fifty five** percent. **Bone pain** (especially spine and ribs) and **fatigue** dominate early symptoms. **CRAB** features (calcium, renal, anaemia, bone) summarise end organ damage at diagnosis. **Renal failure** affects nearly **25** percent at presentation, usually from **cast nephropathy** (protein casts in kidney tubules).
steps.say: Myeloma affects older adults with a median age near seventy years. Bone pain and fatigue are common early symptoms. Renal failure affects nearly twenty five percent at presentation.

steps.tx: **SPEP** (serum protein electrophoresis, protein separation test) finds the **M spike** (abnormal antibody peak) and quantifies **M protein** (monoclonal antibody). **Serum immunofixation** (sensitive antibody test) confirms clonality and light chain type. **Serum free light chains** (sFLC, unbound antibody chains) and kappa lambda ratio expose light chain only disease. **Urine immunofixation** and **24 hour urine protein** complete the baseline panel.
steps.say: SPEP finds and quantifies the M spike in serum. Immunofixation confirms clonality and light chain type. Free light chains are the test for light chain disease.

steps.tx: **R ISS** (Revised International Staging System) stratifies newly diagnosed myeloma with beta 2 microglobulin, albumin, **LDH** (cell damage enzyme) and cytogenetics. **del17p** (chromosome 17 loss) and **t(4;14)** (chromosome translocation) mark high risk disease. **t(11;14)** (chromosome translocation) marks standard risk and **BCMA** (B cell maturation antigen) sensitive disease. **Gain 1q** (extra chromosome arm) pushes risk upward and predicts early relapse. **Trisomy thirteen nineteen** (extra chromosomes) also carry favourable weight.
steps.say: R ISS staging is based on beta 2 microglobulin albumin and cytogenetics. Del17p and t4 14 are high risk markers. Gain 1q is a marker of early relapse patterns.

steps.tx: Transplant eligible patients need quadruplet induction. **Daratumumab** (anti CD38 antibody) combined with **VRD** (bortezomib, lenalidomide, dexamethasone) forms **Dara VRD** (daratumumab VRD) standard induction. **Bortezomib** (proteasome inhibitor) is dosed **one point three** mg per square metre on days **1 4 8 11**. **Lenalidomide** (immunomodulatory drug) is **25** mg daily for **21** days per cycle. **Autologous transplant** (ASCT, own stem cells) follows induction in eligible patients.
steps.say: Daratumumab VRD forms standard induction for transplant eligible patients. Bortezomib is dosed at one point three milligrams. Autologous transplant follows induction in eligible patients.

rows: one point three mg per sq m

steps.tx: **Lenalidomide maintenance** (continuing drug) follows ASCT and extends survival in most patients. **MRD** (measurable residual disease, tiny residual clone) negativity at **10** to the minus **5** predicts longer control and guides duration. **Bisphosphonates** (bone strengthening drugs) prevent skeletal events and are standard in myeloma. **BCMA directed therapy** (CAR T cells) rescues relapsed disease in late lines.
steps.say: Lenalidomide maintenance after transplant extends survival in most patients. MRD negativity predicts considerably longer disease control. Bisphosphonate treatment prevents skeletal events in myeloma patients.

steps.tx: **AL amyloidosis** (light chain amyloid disease) deposits toxic light chains in heart and kidney. **Congo red staining** (amyloid dye test) with **apple green birefringence** (polarised light colour) proves tissue amyloid. **NT proBNP** (heart failure marker) and **troponin** (heart damage marker) stage cardiac disease. **dFLC** (difference between involved and uninvolved free light chains) below **50** mg per litre predicts better survival.
steps.say: AL amyloidosis is seen with light chain deposits in heart and kidney. Congo red staining with apple green birefringence proves amyloid. Low dFLC is a marker of better survival outcomes.

steps.tx: **Waldenstrom macroglobulinaemia** (WM, IgM lymphoplasmacytic disease) secretes **IgM** (large antibody) that thickens blood. **Hyperviscosity** (thick blood symptoms) causes blurred vision, headache and bleeding from mucosal surfaces. **MYD88 L265P** (gene mutation) is found in over **90** percent of cases and supports diagnosis. **Rituximab** (anti CD20 antibody) can flare IgM and worsen hyperviscosity transiently, so plasmapheresis precedes it when IgM is very high.
steps.say: Waldenstrom disease secretes large IgM that thickens blood. Hyperviscosity causes blurred vision and mucosal bleeding. MYD88 mutation supports the diagnosis in most cases worldwide.

steps.tx: Exam stems test these discriminators. **MGUS** (silent clone) never gets treatment and progresses near **1** percent yearly. **Solitary plasmacytoma** (single clone without marrow spread) needs radiation, not systemic chemotherapy. **POEMS syndrome** (polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy, M protein, skin changes) mimics myeloma but **VEGF** (growth factor) is the diagnostic driver. **Castleman disease** (lymph node disorder) overlaps POEMS features closely.
steps.say: MGUS never receives treatment and is a slowly progressive disease. Solitary plasmacytoma needs radiation rather than chemotherapy. POEMS syndrome is a VEGF excess disease pattern.

steps.tx: High-yield for the exam: **MGUS** needs M protein under **3** grams per decilitre and clone under **10** percent. **SLiM** thresholds are clone **60** percent, light chain ratio **100**, and MRI lesions above **1**. **Bortezomib** is **one point three** mg per square metre, and **lenalidomide** is **25** mg daily. **AL amyloid** shows **Congo red** apple green birefringence, and **Waldenstrom** carries **MYD88** mutation.
steps.say: MGUS needs clone below ten percent and M protein below three grams. SLiM thresholds cover sixty percent marrow and ratio one hundred. Bortezomib is dosed at one point three milligrams.

rows: one point three mg per sq m
